note: #513 S2 Task 11. Every one of the 94 baseline cases maps to a survivor in the three canonical suites. 90 map by exact callback hash. The four below map by fully-qualified name with a deliberate, minimal edit, recorded here because a deletion is not allowed on matching assertion text alone.

equivalences.qualifiedName: <SettingsOverlay /> > `s` is a no-op while a modal is open (no stacked overlay)
equivalences.edit: The in-body `await import('../src/store/store')` became `'../store/store'`, because the file moved one directory closer to the module. Nothing else in the callback changed.

equivalences.qualifiedName: <SettingsOverlay /> > alerts fieldset (T9) > renders read-only threshold summary line from alertsConfig (spec §8.1)
equivalences.edit: Same single import-specifier rewrite as above.

equivalences.qualifiedName: <SettingsOverlay /> > alerts fieldset (T9) > test alert button surfaces toast AND error when dispatch returns spawn_error
equivalences.assertions: same two facts — the toast still surfaces AND the error text still contains 'spawn_error' — read from a different element
equivalences.edit: The selector moved from `.modal-error` to `.settings-error-summary`. §2.3 protocol 3 moved the test action's output to the persistent error region, because a response can arrive after its row has been filtered away.

equivalences.qualifiedName: <SettingsOverlay /> Codex budget toggles > renders both toggles disabled + a CLI hint when no Codex budget is configured
equivalences.assertions: same three facts, with the third scoped
equivalences.edit: The `cctally budget set 200 --vendor codex` assertion is scoped to the Codex fieldset with `within(...)`. The CLI-only manifest rows added in Task 7 legitimately name the same command, so the unscoped query now matches more than one node.
